text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the prohibition of parking from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Playfair Avenue, between Eugene Street and Caledonia Road. Currently, generally parking is allowed on both sides of the street for up to three hours. The proposed change will address traffic congestion caused by vehicles parked on both sides of the street.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Playfair Avenue, between Eugene Street and Caledonia Road. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Playfair Avenue, Caledonia Road and a point 38 metres west of Caledonia Road.
